code.description: stream_unavailable is the 406 of a create-investigation request that asks for the event stream (Accept: text/event-stream) while the deployment has the stream turned off. It is written before any admission work and is not retryable. submission_mismatch, submission_in_progress, submission_unsaved and submission_abandoned are the 409s of a create-investigation request whose X-ACR-Submission-ID was already admitted: a different request under that id; its run still live (retryable, with Retry-After); answered but not stored; ended without an answer. None of them runs the request again. submission_required is the 400 of a create-investigation request by a browser-class credential that names no single well-formed X-ACR-Submission-ID (missing, malformed or repeated): refused before admission and model work, nothing ran, and it is not retryable as sent. concurrency_limited and allowance_exhausted are the 429s of a create-investigation request that names a new X-ACR-Submission-ID over a shared Ask Dev limit: running runs per principal or per organization (details.limit principal or org), or the organization's monthly allowance of runs on the deployment's model. Both carry Retry-After; nothing was admitted. thread_closed is the 409 of a create-investigation request whose X-ACR-Thread-ID, or X-ACR-Submission-ID, belongs to a conversation of the caller that was deleted, has expired or is full (1000000 turns): nothing ran, and the request is not retryable under those ids; start a new conversation. canceled, run_lost and cursor_expired belong to the run lease (CHAOS-11949): canceled (409) is the terminal error of a run its owner canceled; run_lost (503) is the terminal error of a run whose service instance stopped and whose lease ended; neither is retryable under the submission id. cursor_expired (410) is the answer to an attach whose Last-Event-ID the event log cannot serve (malformed, never written, older than the kept window, or at or past the terminal): read the submission status and replay the result by id instead. access_denied, no_repository and budget_exhausted are the per-call access read's refusals of a call by a user-class credential (browser, OAuth user, native device), which re-reads the user's access live on every protected call: access_denied is the 403 when the user is not a member of the organization, is impersonating, the browser credential's session is not live, or the organization or user is unknown (one code for every reason, not retryable); no_repository is the 409 when the credential's repository grant within the organization's live repository inventory is empty (not retryable as sent); budget_exhausted is the 503 of a create-investigation request whose wait budget left after the access read is below the minimum, refused before admission with nothing run (retryable).

details.description: Closed safe keys only. For a 400 invalid_request about the request body, details.reason is malformed_json, schema_violation, unknown_field, trailing_json or body_too_large, and details.field, when present, is the JSON path of the failing field. A budget_refusal is a 413 for a valid request whose answer did not fit the response budget; details carry the closed budget keys that route measured (overrun, measured_items, measured_bytes, max_items, max_serialized_bytes, retry_attempted, narrower_continuation); every key is optional and a route sends only the ones it measured.

limit.description: On a 429 rate_limited: which limit refused the request. request_budget is the organization's request budget; capabilities_budget is the capabilities handshake's own budget, spent by the caller-resolution call every MCP request makes; the credential was already decided in both cases. On a 429 concurrency_limited (CHAOS-11914): principal or org, the shared running-run limit that refused the submission. A consumer treats a value outside this enum as absent.

deadline.description: On a 504 upstream_unavailable: which deadline ended the investigation. model is one model attempt reaching its own timeout (ACR_CONTEXT_FABRIC_MODEL_TIMEOUT) before the request deadline; request is the request deadline (ACR_REQUEST_TIMEOUT or the caller's shorter wait budget). Absent when the answer cannot tell which. A consumer treats a value outside this enum as absent.
